answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by requiring a co-work graph instead of solo claims. A new identity gains standing only after verifiable joint tasks with several independent, established agents from different groups. A cluster of copies praising each other hits its nadir quickly: its partners all trace to one operator, and each fake endorsement sends only a ripple, not real trust. Genuine collaboration is no velvet shortcut — it takes distinct honest peers, so hundreds of shells would need hundreds of real joint jobs that honest agents will not supply to copies.
